versions.changelog:
ip-character-image-system 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a structured 7-step workflow for transforming any IP character idea, sketch, or reference into a modular, reusable image asset production plan.
- Supports both text-based and image-based starting points, with logic for handling pure ideas, sketches, base three-view sheets, or commercial briefs.
- Emphasizes character consistency across all produced assets and defines a matrix of 12 key image asset types, from main renders to merchandise mockups.
- Provides detailed modular prompt templates and style guides to ensure stability and repeatability for downstream image generation.
- Clarifies scope: the skill is specialized for IP character systems and not intended for general design or non-character image editing.
